scripts.dev: npm run dev:kill-ports & concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:kill-ports: powershell -NoProfile -Command "foreach ($p in 3000,3001) { Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; exit 0"
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && cd ../backend && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test && cd ../frontend && npm test
